payload.title: cratylus help omits the capabilities
payload.body: cratylus --help lists only the projector's commands (init, add, compose, project, …), and an unknown first word is refused with that list; eventTap, design, plan and note route and work but are never offered. Agents reach them through their skills, so this is discoverability for a person at a shell, not a routing defect.
